source: Identified-model table: physics (MuJoCo biped, frozen gait dr-default-s0) vs the NavGym v2/v4 randomization box, + follow-up corrections (build_final.py)

rows.q: FOPDT model (walking 0.15-0.35 m/s, |u| = 1)
rows.verdict: gain inside; tau outside (gym-form 0.06-0.08 s vs the gym's 0.15 s floor: 2-2.5x faster than its fastest draw, 3-4x faster than nominal; ~60 % of the steady-state response inside the first 40 ms step vs 0 % nominal, 27 % fastest draw); latency at the gym's lower edge (0)

rows.q: steady-state gain at |u|=1 (walking 0.15-0.35 m/s)
steady-state gain at |u|=1 (in place)
gain at |u|=0.6 (all speeds)
gain at |u|=0.3 walking (concave input map)
rows.verdict: outside (above at 0.15 m/s; gym is linear)

rows.q: gain at |u|=0.3 in place (dead zone)
first-order tau, continuous FOPDT on the integrated step (s)
rows.gym_note: gym fitted by the same procedure
rows.note: most walking fits sit at the 0.01 s grid floor (response complete within the first 40 ms step); range shown is |u|=1 walking and in place; in-place |u|=0.6 is slower (0.26 s) and excluded; |u|=0.3 in place does not turn

rows.q: tau in the gym's own discrete form, PRBS fit (s) / latency (steps)
dead time (s), continuous fit
FIR step response after 1 / 2 policy steps (PRBS p=0.02-0.7)
rows.note: phys values are per unit command (steady-state gain 1.02-1.11), i.e. ~0.6 / ~1.0 of the steady-state rate after 1 / 2 steps; gym nominal (0.25 s, 1 step) 0 / 0.16 of steady state

rows.q: max rate at the interface limit |u|=1 (rad/s)
rows.note: |u|=1.5 (not reachable through W_MAX=1): 1.50 in place, 1.31 at 0.35 m/s -> the gait is not rate-saturated at 1 rad/s

rows.q: bang-bang square wave +-1 at 0.30 m/s: gain of the fundamental 0.5/1.5/3/6.25 Hz, every-step flip (12.5 Hz)
rows.gym_note: slow corner (1.17, 0.45 s, 2 steps) and fast corner (1.17, 0.15 s, 0 steps)
rows.verdict: outside (bandwidth ~6 Hz vs 0.35-1.1 Hz: 3x the fast-corner gain at 6.25 Hz, 1.5x at every-step flips)
rows.note: run at vx 0.30 (phys_experiments.block_square), not 0.35; the 1.5 Hz point (0.74) is non-monotonic -- likely interference with the 1.71 Hz stride wobble (0.28 rad/s RMS) in a 10 s window; 3 seeds agree within 0.02. -3 dB bandwidth: physics ~6 Hz (0.76 at 6.25 Hz relative to 1.02 at 0.5 Hz) vs the gym's first-order corner 1/(2 pi tau) = 0.35-1.06 Hz (0.64 nominal)

rows.q: square-wave phase lag at 0.5/1.5/3/6.25 Hz (deg)
rows.note: gym lists are [fast corner (1.17, 0.15 s, 0 steps)], [slow corner (1.17, 0.45 s, 2 steps)]; 6.25 Hz slow-corner value is wrapped (= -222 deg)

rows.q: mean of a +-1 chatter while walking (0.3 m/s): realized rate for duty-cycle mean m=0.33/0.5/0.75, iid chatter
in place: realized rate for const / fastest-PWM / iid chatter of mean 0.33, 0.5, 0.75
rows.verdict: outside (dead zone; PWM of mean <= 0.5 does not turn)

rows.q: braked to standstill in a maze (s5, training maze 9001, physics closed loop): 0.48 s windows
per-step heading change under the actors' own chatter (deg, median / p90)
rows.verdict: outside (median 1.3-4x the gym's, p90 1.4x; max 5.9 deg per 40 ms step)

rows.q: stride wobble: yaw-rate RMS (rad/s) / heading p-p (deg) / freq (Hz) at 0.35 m/s
rows.verdict: outside (periodic, larger RMS; heading effect only +-2 deg)

rows.q: heading drift walking straight (rad/s) at 0.15 / 0.25 / 0.35 m/s
FOPDT model (start from standstill, 0.25-0.35 m/s)
rows.verdict: start inside (fast edge); stop outside (faster); low-speed dead zone outside

rows.q: steady-state gain at 0.15 / 0.25 / 0.35 m/s
rows.map: v = max(0, 1.19 v_cmd - 0.063): no motion below 0.053 m/s
rows.verdict: inside at 0.25-0.35; outside at 0.15 and below 0.053 (dead zone)

rows.q: start tau (s) from standstill at 0.25 / 0.35 m/s
start from standstill at 0.15 m/s
rows.note: not first-order: the FOPDT fit sits at its 3.0 s bound; the gait shuffles ~1.5-3.5 s before stepping

rows.q: stop: travel after a stop command from 0.25 / 0.35 m/s (cm, signed, along heading, 2 s)
rows.verdict: outside (faster: stops in < 1 step; the gym lags the stop like the start)
rows.note: the previous FOPDT stop fit (tau 0.01-0.03 s) is on stride-noisy per-step speed; the coast distance is the robust number: the gait stops within one step (even steps back 1-4 cm)

rows.q: start delay-equivalent (v_ss*3s - s(3s))/v_ss from standstill at 0.25 / 0.35 m/s (s)
dead time (s)
max speed at v_cmd = V_MAX (m/s)
speed ratio during a constant turn at 0.35 m/s, |u|=1 / |u|=1.5
speed ratio under +-1 chatter: PRBS p=0.5/0.7 (0.3 m/s) / 3 Hz square / the actors' own sequences
rows.verdict: outside (5-10 % loss under PRBS, 26 % at 3 Hz; 1-3 % on the actors' own sequences)

rows.q: lateral sway: lateral-speed RMS (m/s) at 0.35 m/s
team_sensors speed brake: v *= clip((clear - 0.42)/0.48, 0, 1), +-25 deg forward cone, 10 Hz packets (+ depth term)
rows.gym: absent (collision ends the episode at 0.22 m)
rows.note: maze_braked_frac_* are per-episode means over the 12 scored traces (read-only); step-weighted: s5 0.397, s6 0.248, A* 0.051; IMU term fired on 5 of 27685 s6 steps, 0 for s5/A*; the gym re-creation (sysid_env.py) omits the stereo-depth term (unverified, likely minor: flat-floor false braking 0.6 % straight / 3 % under chatter)

rows.q: lidar/map pipeline: 10 Hz packets held 2-3 steps; biped --policy path integrates each packet at the NEXT step's pose
rows.phys: maze_explore.py run_seed (biped branch, learned['emap'].update at the loop top)
rows.gym: fresh scan each step at the current pose
